Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
Rebecca Guay has been a fan-favorite artist ever since she first illustrated three cards for the Alliances expansion in 1996. Since then, Rebecca has contributed more than 150 pieces to Magic: The Gathering, including some of the most iconic and evocative art the game has seen. With this series, Rebecca brings her distinctive artistic style and poetry to some fantastic cards, including the first reprint of Serra the Benevolent and an all-new take on Stoneforge Mystic. Muy Guay!

Contents:
• 1x Foil Cleansing Nova
• 1x Foil Serra the Benevolent
• 1x Foil Stoneforge Mystic
• 1x Foil Muddle the Mixture
